embed.description: We are thrilled to have you as part of our growing community. Please take a moment to review our rules and guidelines before starting your roleplay journey.

discordRules.title: 🔍 DISCORD COMMUNITY GUIDELINES
discordRules.value:
​
➤ **Be Respectful:** Treat all members and staff with respect at all times.

➤ **No Toxicity or Hate Speech:** Toxic behavior, discrimination, and drama are strictly prohibited.

➤ **Proper Channels:** Keep discussions, media, and clips in their designated channels.

➤ **No Advertising:** DM advertising or self-promotion without staff permission will lead to an instant ban.

dmWelcome.message: Welcome to **Novyra Roleplay**! Make sure to read the server rules and enjoy your stay!
